newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN GOVT BACKS MAJOR NEW PORT PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN GOVT BACKS MAJOR NEW PORT PROJECT.

text.p: A South African ministerial committee has thrown its support behind a proposed new port and industrial development zone at Coega near Port Elizabeth, the Department of Trade and Industry said on Tuesday.

The scheme's backers say the planned bulk harbour and adjacent industral zone will attract major industry to the Eastern Cape, creating thousands of jobs in one of the most depressed regions of the country.
Catalyst for the scheme is a planned 220,000-tonnes-a-year zinc refinery which Gencor Ltd is considering building.
The ministerial committee will work with pronvincial and local government officials to finalise necessary technical and consultative work to put to cabinet, the department said.
"This is an important step forward in the development plans of the country and province," it said in a statement.
